text: If this is about the boat, please keep your voice down.
When does the next boat leave?
The boat from the mainland returns before the baby is born.
Artur and I agreed to put Ivo on that trip.
Who decided on the trip?
It was a conversation among villagers, not a written order.
What did you hear from Helena?
I know she is expecting a baby and wanted the father nearby.
End the conversation.
If you're looking for my father, he should be on the steps.
How is Helena?
My mother is expecting a baby.
She wanted my father here when the baby is born.
Now everyone only talks about when he will leave.
When does the boat return?
I heard it returns before the baby is born, but I have not seen the schedule.
What do you know about the decision?
My father did not choose the date; the village discussed it.
End the conversation.
Careful near the edge. Some stones still need securing.
What are you working on?
I am fixing the steps for Helena and Luana.
What is the blue strip on your sleeve?
A strip of blue cloth got caught while I was working.
Tell Ivo about the boat schedule.
Nuno had mentioned it, but thank you for confirming.
Tell Ivo what you heard about Helena.
I wanted to be with her when the baby arrived.
How did you hear about the trip?
Nuno told me the boat returns before the baby is born.
Talk about this morning’s boat.
The time for the trip is approaching; I will finish the steps before boarding.
What do you know about the village?
The village discussed my departure, but I did not hear every reason.
Why do you have to leave before the baby is born?
The village has already chosen me to leave beforehand.
I wanted to be here with Helena when the baby arrived.
End the conversation.
